mesa-peacemaker-general: All of Mesa's damage comes from Peacemaker/Regulators; stacking weapon multipliers (Galvanized Shot, Nourish Viral) beats raw strength for DPS. Shatter Shield + Adaptation + Rolling Guard keep you alive.
mesa-peacemaker-sp: Narrow Minded + Umbral strength give long Peacemaker/Shatter Shield uptime; Umbral Vitality + Adaptation + Primed Sure Footed keep you standing in Steel Path. Nourish covers both Viral and the energy loop.
saryn-spore-general: Spores + Miasma spread Viral/corrosive and strip armor; Venom Dose turns weapon damage into Spore contagion. Brief Respite + Catalyzing Shields let you shield-gate indefinitely.
saryn-spore-sp: Level-cap endurance: spore scaling + Molt Efficiency makes the kit nearly free; shield-gating grants immortality. Molt Augmented stacks strength over long runs. (For speedruns, keeping Molt and replacing Miasma is also common.)
wisp-support-general: Very high strength (~400%+) maxes the Haste/Vitality/Shock motes and Roar; Archon Intensify grants +30% strength when you heal with an ability. Pure team-support role.
wisp-breach-sp: Will-O-Wisp invisibility + the passive keep you alive; Breach Surge sparks + the Eclipse multiplier clear rooms. The 2026 Breach Surge buff (18m range, guaranteed spark on lethal hits) made this build stronger. High forma = endgame investment.
nekros-desecrate-general: Despoil makes Desecrate cost 10 HP per corpse instead of energy; Equilibrium turns health orbs into energy — an infinite loop. Range stacking (Overextended + Stretch + Augur Reach) means extra loot chance from every corpse. Want tank? Put Shield of Shadows in slot 8.
nekros-oregaze-sp: Desecrate + Petrify (Ore Gaze augment) are two separate loot sources; Umbral Vitality + Adaptation + Health Conversion plus the constant health-orb stream make you very tanky in Steel Path. Resource farm and durability in one.
revenant-mesmer-general: High strength raises the Mesmer Skin charge count (every 16.67% strength = +1 charge) — near-total damage/status immunity. A simple, unkillable weapon platform.
revenant-lichking-sp: Very high strength yields 19-22 Mesmer Skin charges; the Mesmer Shield augment shares them with the squad. Roar lowers the Viral stacks needed for a one-shot Reave; Equilibrium feeds the energy loop.
khora-whipclaw-general: Whipclaw scales with the melee combo counter and your melee mods; Accumulating Whipclaw stacks up to +350% damage (+35% per kill batch). Group enemies with Ensnare and pop them with one Whipclaw. Venari provides passive healing.
khora-pilfering-sp: Pilfering Strangledome drops 65% extra loot from enemies dying in the dome — it stacks with Nekros (the two pillars of resource farming). Range stacking grows the dome; Whipclaw into the dome builds combo and damage. Umbral Intensify offsets Overextended's strength loss.
octavia-mallet-general: Mallet absorbs enemy fire and reflects it back — the higher the enemy level, the harder it hits, so it scales forever. Grab invisibility with the Metronome's Vivace rhythm; Amp boosts both Mallet and weapon damage.
octavia-endurance-sp: Narrow Minded extends duration; Stretch + Augur Reach recover the lost range. The loop: drop Mallet + Resonator, take Metronome buffs for invisibility and speed, then Amp everything. Played right it reaches level cap; Nullifiers are the only real threat.
volt-speed-general: Speed boosts the whole squad and melee attack speed; Discharge delivers wide-area CC plus electric damage. Plant the Shield as cover and keep running. Simple, flexible, fits any content.
volt-capacitance-sp: Capacitance converts part of Discharge's damage into overshields for you and the squad — with Brief Respite it forms a constant shield-gate loop. Overextended + Stretch open a huge Discharge area; Umbral + Blind Rage recover the strength.
rhino-ironskin-general: Iron Skin scales with armor and strength; before casting, dive into a crowd with an Ironclad Charge-boosted Rhino Charge — every enemy hit multiplies your armor — then cast Iron Skin. Roar boosts the whole team's damage. The sturdiest tank for newer players.
rhino-roar-sp: Iron Skin alone is not enough in Steel Path; this build focuses on being a team multiplier with high-strength Roar + Nourish Viral. Umbral Vitality + Adaptation carry the health pool. Roar double-dips on DoTs, making it precious in Slash/Viral squads.
wukong-twin-general: The Twin fires your other weapon on its own — hand it a good primary and get two players' DPS. Defy absorbs damage into armor, Cloud Walker heals and repositions. Nourish adds Viral and energy economy.
wukong-defy-sp: Defy's armor scales with strength and absorbed damage; the Umbral set + Adaptation make you nearly immortal in Steel Path. Cloud Walker is escape and full heal in one. The passive grants extra lives; Equilibrium relaxes the energy loop.
dante-tragedy-sp: The loop: 2x Dark Verse + Final Verse = Tragedy, detonating every status effect in the room. The Light Verse combo stacks Overguard on the squad; Pageflight marks and staggers crowds, and Noctua works as a real weapon. The kit is complete — no Helminth needed.
protea-artillery-sp: Place Blaze Artillery at chokepoints where enemies flow — it scales with strength and duration, and Roar multiplies its damage. Grenade Fan's alt-fire drops shield satellites (shield-gate support), the held cast throws shrapnel. Dispensary feeds the squad energy, health and ammo.
gauss-thermal-sp: In 2026 Steel Path Gauss doubles as an area nuke: with Thermal Transfer, cast Cold then Heat Thermal Sunder to freeze and cook the room. Redline overdrives fire/move/reload speed; Kinetic Plating turns damage into battery. The fastest frame in the game.
nova-slowva-sp: Molecular Prime slows enemies by 75% and chains death explosions — the queen of defense and survival. Null Star particles one-shot weak contacts; Molecular Fission replenishes them on kills (detonate with Neutron Star). Archon Vitality doubles MPrime's Heat.
styanax-finalstand-sp: Intrepid Stand stacks Overguard on you and the squad with every Final Stand javelin hit — the whole team becomes nearly unkillable. Tharros Strike strips armor/shields and refills your shields (shield-gate), Rally Point streams energy to allies. Not a solo nuke — the team's backbone.
cyte09-neutralize-sp: The Seek antenna marks enemies through walls and boosts weak-point damage by 75%; Resupply refills magazines with elemental ammo (snipers get +50%). Evade grants invisibility that extends on weak-point kills; Neutralize summons a ricocheting exalted sniper. A single-target specialist for solo/duo Steel Path.
uriel-brimstone-sp: 2026's demon commander: you lead three demons (Catenach, Gulphagor, Vythelas). Remedium heals you and revives fallen demons; Demonium applies vulnerability; Brimstone wipes rooms with an expanding ring of flame — hence the range stacking. Archon Vitality doubles the Heat damage.
nokko-mushroom-sp: Plant a mushroom ring around the objective and watch: Stinkbrain applies Viral + sleep, Brightbonnet pulses energy and strength buffs, Sporespring launches bouncing explosive mushrooms. Archon Continuity adds Corrosive to Toxin procs. Reroot makes you untargetable while healing. Survival's new camp master.
mirage-hall-general: Hall of Mirrors clones effectively multiply your carried weapon's damage — superb with AoE guns (Kuva Zarr, Torid). Eclipse gives a damage multiplier in light or damage reduction in darkness. She is fragile: cover the gap with Rolling Guard + Adaptation.
titania-razorwing-sp: In Razorwing, Dex Pixia carries you — modded separately with pistol mods (Hornet Strike, the Galvanized set), and Arcane Velocity sends its fire rate flying. As a tiny aerial target with Aviator + Adaptation you are very durable. Don't forget Tribute buffs.
baruuk-serenestorm-sp: As Restraint erodes, Desert Wind (exalted fists) unlocks — its wave punches clear Steel Path rooms and are modded on the melee screen. Elude + Lull give passive defense and sleep CC; Desolate Hands shreds incoming fire. Hits hard, refuses to die.
xaku-grasp-sp: Grasp of Lohk steals enemy guns and turns them into auto-firing Void turrets around you — with range stacking you collect dozens. The Vast Untime grants 75% damage reduction (skeletal form); Gaze strips armor/shields. Void damage treats every faction equally.
jade-glory-sp: Hover with Glory on High, hold primary fire and detonate Judgment wells with the alt-fire. Light's Judgment heals allies while applying 50% damage vulnerability; Ophanim Eyes slows, strips and even revives remotely. Her passive grants two aura slots — big team value.
hildryn-pillage-sp: Pillage strips enemy shields/armor by percentage and feeds them into your own shields — the strength stacking is aimed at a full strip. She spends shields instead of energy, so shield-gating comes naturally; Haven shields teammates. A support that is very hard to kill.
harrow-covenant-sp: Covenant grants brief full immortality, then huge team crit chance — Harrow's signature. Thurible generates energy from kills, Penance adds lifesteal and fire rate, Condemn refills shields and locks crowds. Not a glove — a conductor: timing is everything.
citrine-crystal-sp: Fractured Blast rains health orbs (Equilibrium turns them into energy), Preserving Shell wraps the team in scaling damage reduction, Prismatic Gem supports crit/status. Quiet, but a true backbone frame that keeps the squad standing.
ash-shuriken-sp: Seeking Shuriken fully strips armor at sufficient strength; Blade Storm shreds everything marked, Smoke Screen grants invisibility. Silent, fast, merciless on single targets.
atlas-landslide-sp: Landslide is a chained punch combo that scales with your melee mods; you take no damage mid-punch. Keep collecting Rubble to refresh armor — played right, Atlas is immovable.
banshee-sonar-sp: Sonar paints weak points that multiply the whole team's damage; Resonance chains new spots on kills. Savage Silence stuns and opens a huge finisher multiplier. Glass cannon: Rolling Guard is mandatory.
caliban-fusion-sp: Post-rework Caliban is seriously strong: Fusion Strike's intersection leaves a lasting full armor/shield strip zone, Lethal Progeny regenerates shields and fields Sentient offspring. Sentient Wrath lifts the crowd.
chroma-vex-sp: Vex Armor stacks huge armor (Scorn) and weapon damage (Fury) as you take damage — still one of the best boss/Eidolon buffers. Pick the element color for your purpose (white/grey = extra armor).
dagath-doom-sp: The Doom mark applies Viral and amplifies all damage against marked enemies; Wyrd Scythes slow and slice, and Rakhali's spectral horses trample the room. Her passive cheats lethal blows.
ember-exothermic-sp: Fire Blast strips armor, Inferno burns the room; Exothermic drops energy orbs on kills and Archon Vitality doubles Heat. Manage the Immolation gauge around 90% without letting it overflow.
equinox-maim-sp: Night form sleeps enemies and slows them via Peaceful Provocation; day-form Maim unleashes the stored Slash damage across the room. Two frames in one — switch forms to fit the moment.
excalibur-chromatic-sp: Chromatic Blade changes Exalted Blade's element to match your energy color and skyrockets its status chance (pick Corrosive or Viral). Radial Blind opens finisher windows; Umbra's innate Umbral polarities make the build cheaper.
frost-avalanche-sp: Avalanche fully strips armor at sufficient strength; Icy Avalanche layers Overguard on the team per kill. Biting Frost grants crit bonuses against frozen targets; Snow Globe is still the best objective cover.
garuda-talons-sp: Dread Mirror blocks all frontal damage and charges a damage payload; Seeking Talons opens a massive Slash window. Blood Forge reloads your magazines for free while on Blood Altar. Her passive hits harder at low health — play brave.
grendel-feast-sp: Every enemy in your belly adds armor; swallow with Feast, digest buffs with Nourish (this is where Nourish lives at full power), and spit toxic projectiles with Regurgitate. Slow but uncrushable.
gyre-rotorswell-sp: With Rotorswell active, your crits discharge electricity around you — the whole kit feeds on crit-chance buffs. Cathode Current extends the 4 on kills; Coil Horizon gathers and pops the crowd.
hydroid-pilfering-sp: His rework passive stacks Corrosive on enemies; Tentacle Swarm + Pilfering Swarm squeeze extra loot from grabbed enemies (triple-farm with Nekros/Khora). Plunder steals armor and adds it to yours.
inaros-scarab-sp: Post-rework Scarab Shell blocks status (and Negation Armor eats lethal hits); the giant health pool + Adaptation + Grace make him practically immortal. Simple, durable, goes anywhere.
ivara-prowl-sp: Prowl is permanent invisibility plus loot stolen from enemies; Infiltrate lets you pass laser barriers and adds speed. The undisputed master of Spy, Riven unlocks and camp hunting.
koumei-fate-sp: The dice frame: Omamori rolling triple-six grants invulnerability, Omikuji hands out permanent Decrees for completing challenges — she snowballs over long runs. Kumihimo threads apply random elements; Archon Continuity adds Corrosive to Toxin.
kullervo-wrath-sp: Wrathful Advance is a short teleport plus a massive melee crit buff — it turns any melee into a red-crit monster. Recompense stacks Overguard, Storm of Ukko rains daggers. The dream frame for melee lovers.
lavos-alchemy-sp: Uses cooldowns instead of energy — no Energize needed. Hold ability keys to infuse any element into any cast (Corrosive/Viral on demand); Catalyze shortens cooldowns. The element master fits every faction.
limbo-stasis-sp: Cataclysm + Stasis: everything inside the bubble freezes while the objective stays untouched — the king of Mobile Defense and rescues. Cataclysmic Continuum extends duration on kills. Mind pulling teammates into the Rift uninvited.
loki-invis-sp: Long invisibility (fully silent with Hushed) + Radial Disarm turns the deadliest room into a stick fight. Switch Teleport is still the best trickster/rescue tool. The classic of Spy and solo sabotage.
mag-magnetize-sp: Every bullet fired into the Magnetize bubble ricochets and multiplies inside — it detonates weapon damage on single targets. Fracturing Crush adds armor strip to Crush; Polarize shatters shields and refills yours. A shield-gate master.
nezha-safeguard-sp: Warding Halo cuts damage by 90%; with Safeguard you wrap allies and objectives in halos too. Divine Spears skewers the room, Blazing Chakram drops health orbs. Fast, durable, team-friendly.
nidus-mutation-sp: Gather with Larva, hit with Virulence: every strike builds Mutation stacks that raise both damage and durability, and at 15 stacks you cheat death. Abundant Mutation accelerates stack generation. The marathon runner of endless missions.
nyx-assimilate-sp: Chaos turns the whole room against itself — the cheapest crowd control there is; Chaos Sphere keeps refreshing the area. Assimilate makes Absorb a walking immortality bubble. The rework turned the Mind Control target into a real weapon.
oberon-paladin-sp: Renewal heals continuously; Phoenix Renewal converts lethal damage into a revive every two minutes. Hallowed Ground cleanses and blocks status, Reckoning blinds with Radiation and strips armor. A complete team anchor.
oraxia-spider-sp: 2026's spider frame: Webbed Embrace cocoons apply +50% damage vulnerability, Widow's Brood spawns Scuttlers from poisoned kills. Silken Stride grants status immunity and doubled health while you leap wall to wall. Archon Continuity adds Corrosive to Toxin.
qorvex-radiation-sp: The Chyrinka Pillar slows the zone and pulses Radiation; Disometric Guard grants the squad status immunity. Crucible Blast detonates enemies carrying five Radiation stacks in chain explosions. Concrete build, strong area control.
sevagoth-gloom-sp: Gloom slows everything around you and converts your hits into lifesteal (the Helminth ability everyone wants — at full power here). Reap + Sow detonates souls to clear rooms; on death you keep fighting in Shadow form.
temple-backbeat-sp: Cast on the Backbeat metronome and abilities come out free and empowered: Pyrotechnics gains extra pillars, Overdrive doubles crit chance. Lizzie (the exalted guitar) breathes constant Heat — Archon Vitality doubles it. S-tier for anyone who can keep rhythm.
trinity-ev-sp: Energy Vampire is the team's battery: tag a target, energy flows. Blessing instantly heals everyone and adds 75% damage reduction; Champion's Blessing stacks a weapon buff on top. From Eidolons to Netracells — the queen of healers.
valkyr-eternalwar-sp: Warcry grants attack speed and armor; Eternal War extends it forever on melee kills. Talons (exalted claws) are modded separately on the melee screen; Hysteria makes you fully immortal. Rage incarnate.
vauban-bastille-sp: Bastille lifts enemies and steals their armor for you; Vortex sucks everything into one point — a dream pair with AoE weapons. Photon Repeater chains free Photon Strikes. The chief engineer of defense.
voruna-ulfrun-sp: Ulfrun's Descent is a five-charge dive attack that deletes single targets — Slash-heavy and armor-agnostic; the augment refunds charges on kills. Fangs of Raksh applies five different statuses to prime Condition Overload. The power of the wolf pack.
yareli-merulina-sp: Loyal Merulina carries Merulina's damage absorption without riding the board — play secondary-focused and the K-Drive requirement disappears. Aquablades slice constantly; Riptide gathers and pops. The sea girl surfs on land too.
zephyr-turbulence-sp: Turbulence deflects all projectiles — you are effectively immortal against ranged enemies; Jet Stream adds movement and projectile speed. Tornadoes absorb the damage you deal and spread it: feed the storm with an AoE weapon. A floating fortress.
torid-incarnon-sp: The Incarnon form fires a beam that chains between targets; Galvanized mods scale with kills and status. Electric+Toxin = Corrosive strips armor, Hunter Munitions adds Slash bleeds through crits. Requires the Incarnon Genesis adapter and evolutions (Duviri Steel Path Circuit weekly rotation).
phenmor-incarnon-sp: Headshots charge the Incarnon gauge fast; in Incarnon form fire rate and damage multiply. Cold+Toxin = Viral, and Galvanized Scope + Deadhead headshot multipliers melt single targets. One of the strongest single-target/boss options.
felarx-incarnon-sp: Enormous up-close hits; Cold+Toxin = Viral with Blaze adding Heat. The Incarnon form switches to old-fashioned dual pistols raining bullets. Galvanized Savvy scales with status variety.
kuva-zarr-launcher-sp: Cannon mode deals huge area damage; Primed Firestorm grows the blast radius. Cold+Toxin = Viral, and Heat is the recommended progenitor element (Viral+Heat combo). Pair with a Primed Sure Footed frame to shrug off self-staggers.
soma-incarnon-sp: The Hata-Satya Incarnon evolution stacks crit chance on hits, reaching giant crits at full charge. Hunter Munitions converts crits into Slash bleeds; Cold+Toxin = Viral amplifies them. A classic legend still relevant in 2026.
boar-incarnon-sp: The Incarnon form rains explosive pellets applying dozens of statuses per second — Galvanized Savvy multiplies the damage. Cold+Toxin = Viral with Blaze for Heat; Chilling Reload adds Cold and reload speed. A close-to-mid-range room sweeper.
burston-incarnon-sp: The Incarnon form swaps burst fire for a full-auto laser; evolutions push crit and fire rate through the roof. Cold+Toxin = Viral. Cheap, early to obtain, and still near the top in Steel Path.
latron-incarnon-sp: In Incarnon form every shot becomes an explosive cannonball; hits stack damage. Electric+Toxin = Corrosive works on armor. A one-shot-one-kill rifle for the patient marksman.
strun-incarnon-sp: The Incarnon form fires a wide, high-status orb; Galvanized Savvy turns every status into more damage. Cold+Toxin = Viral with Blaze adding Heat. The close-range grinder.
acceltra-rocket-sp: Reload speeds up while sprinting — a natural fit for fast frames like Gauss and Volt. The micro-rockets explode crit-heavy; Primed Firestorm grows the area, Cold+Toxin = Viral. Bombardment on the move.
laetum-incarnon-sp: In Incarnon form the rounds explode for area damage; evolutions stack status or crit as you choose. Electric+Toxin = Corrosive. One of the rare secondaries that clears Steel Path rooms alone.
kuva-nukor-primer: The beam chains across multiple targets; Toxin+Cold = Viral primes enemies for melee/Condition Overload. Pick Heat or Magnetic as the progenitor element. Encumber sprays random extra statuses with every hit.
epitaph-primer: Uncharged rapid fire blankets a wide area with four 60/60 elements plus the weapon's own Cold/Blast procs; Primed Fulmination grows the blast radius. The ideal primer for Condition Overload and Galvanized mods — the statuses carry the damage, not the gun.
dual-toxocyst-incarnon-sp: Headshots trigger Frenzy (fire-rate boost) and charge the Incarnon gauge; the Incarnon form fires explosive high-damage shots. Innate Toxin + Deep Freeze Cold = Viral. One of the peak secondaries of the 2026 meta.
grimoire-primer: The charged shot bursts over a wide area applying all four 60/60 elements at once — a perfect primer for Condition Overload and Galvanized mods. It also has its own tome mod slot (e.g. energy regen). You carry the statuses, not the damage.
lex-incarnon-sp: In Incarnon form every shot becomes an explosive hand cannon round — deleting single targets and rattling everything nearby. Electric+Toxin = Corrosive. The legendary final form of a starter weapon.
atomos-chain-primer: The beam chains between targets; the weapon's innate Heat plus Toxin/Cold mods applies Viral+Heat — both a primer and a low-level melter. Kuva Nukor's humble but still-great ancestor.
tenet-cycron-sp: The magazine refills itself — no reloads, an uninterrupted beam. The chaining shot applies Toxin+Cold = Viral; pick Magnetic or Heat as the progenitor. Lazy but lethal.
sicarus-incarnon-sp: Headshots charge the Incarnon gauge; transformed, it fires explosive bursts. Heat+Electric = Radiation with 60/60s carrying status too. The precision shooter's burst pistol.
glaive-prime-heavy: Throw and detonate mid-air: the heavy-attack explosion deals Slash-weighted area damage. Killing Blow + Corrupt Charge give an instant full-power heavy throw; Amalgam Organ Shatter shortens the charge. Toxin+Cold = Viral. Crescendo banks permanent combo from heavy kills.
dual-ichor-influence: Melee Influence copies electric status to surrounding enemies — Shocking Touch + Focus Energy add pure Electric while the innate Toxin stays separate (no merge). The Incarnon form's poison cloud helps clear rooms. Monstrous in crowded missions.
praedos-parkour: Its Incarnon evolutions grant parkour/sprint speed even while holstered — most players carry Praedos for the speed passive alone. The mod layout is a standard hybrid crit/status; the tonfa itself is solid. Evolution II is the key pick for the speed passive.
kronen-influence-sp: High attack speed + wide reach + hybrid crit/status: Kronen Prime has been the dependable all-content melee for years. Pure Electric + Melee Influence copies every electric proc to the crowd and melts it. Blood Rush/Weeping Wounds overflow as combo grows.
ceramic-dagger-incarnon-sp: Incarnon evolutions turn the modest dagger into a monster: high crit, initial combo and speed bonuses. Paired with a primer (Nukor/Epitaph), Condition Overload goes through the roof. Being accessible at MR5 is its biggest charm.
hate-incarnon-heavy-sp: Incarnon evolutions send crit and heavy-attack efficiency flying; heavy swings reap in a wide arc. Killing Blow + Corrupt Charge deliver instant full-power heavies, Crescendo banks permanent combo from kills. Toxin+Cold = Viral.
innodem-incarnon-sp: The Zariman dagger: in Incarnon form its reach and crit multiply, charged by movement. The fast strike tempo fills Blood Rush/Weeping Wounds instantly. With Kullervo it becomes a red-crit waterfall.
nikana-hybrid-sp: A balanced crit/status katana; Toxin+Cold = Viral and the Slash-heavy strikes bleed. The Blind Justice stance is fast and mobile. With a primer, Condition Overload peaks. Elegant and lethal.
reaper-heavy-sp: The classic high-crit scythe: Killing Blow + Corrupt Charge give instant full-power heavy attacks, and Slash bleeds ignore armor. Toxin+Cold = Viral. Reaper aesthetics, Steel Path performance.
sancti-magistar-incarnon-sp: Its strikes heal you and nearby allies — with Incarnon evolutions it becomes both a hammer and a walking med-station. The heavy-attack frame with Killing Blow/Corrupt Charge aims for one-shot swings. The only weapon that heals as it hits.
xoris-glaive-sp: The combo counter never resets — heavy attacks don't spend it, so glaive detonations always hit at full power. The electric burst stuns; Toxin+Electric = Corrosive. The practical, maintenance-free alternative to Glaive Prime.
